provider: Meta via Muse Code original configuration

reasons: New LotLedger family is operationally distinct from LogLens/IntervalDesk/CSVShape and single-identity no-replacement rule respects no-victory-seeking constraint, but draft is not yet executable.
Functional core is unusually strict and testable, yet several boundary definitions remain ambiguous for a frozen exact contract.
SQLite transactional alternative is substantive in principle, but no measured primitive evidence in fixed image exists yet; docs-only references cannot support baseline honesty.
60-recipe reserved set lacks coverage rationale and frozen evaluator preconditions are only sketched.
Roles/budgets/stopping are well bounded under schema8, but N/S/T multitype comparison and release gates are deferred without pointer to their prospective protocol.

findings.section: Justificación y límite contra selección favorable
findings.issue: Single identity lotledger-delivery-v1 with publish-on-fail is correct, but freeze/registration sequence is informal.
findings.required_change: Require written freeze receipt: exact contract hash plus evaluator hash plus independent review sign-off before first admission; forbid edits after freeze except new identity.

findings.issue: Input size/count limit ambiguous: 65536 bytes inclusive and 1000 events; unclear whether total stdin bytes, treatment of final LF, and oversize handling as invalid_input vs infrastructure fail.
findings.required_change: Define measured unit, inclusive boundary, oversize verdict with exit/streams, and empty vs single-LF vs whitespace-only inputs.

findings.issue: Duplicate/idempotency accounting underspecified: unique_events/duplicate_events counting, first-invalid vs duplicate-invalid precedence, and key-order-only equality need exact rules.
findings.required_change: Specify distinct-id counting, duplicate occurrence counting, that any invalid event invalidates whole input before dedup, and canonical comparison rule without adding implementation.

findings.issue: Output exactness incomplete: top-level/row key sets, key order significance, integer types, single trailing newline, and argv-error streams not fully pinned.
findings.required_change: State exact allowed keys, no-extra-keys rule top and row level, output whitespace/newline rule, and argv-violation exit/streams identical to invalid_input.

findings.issue: Stock model and ordering need closure: key is implied (lot,site), move semantics same-lot cross-site, zero-stock omission, Python string ordering version dependence.
findings.required_change: Explicitly define stock key, move lot invariance, positive-only omission rule, and Python 3.12 string comparison reference with locale-independent behavior.

findings.issue: No measured SQLite primitive observations in fixed image; only two doc URLs dated 2026-10-05. Baseline honesty rule stated but unsatisfied.
findings.required_change: Add prerequisite: pre-generation observable primitive note with image digest, population/procedure/location, and actually measured values; prohibit invented baseline0 and post-hoc copying into criteria.

findings.issue: 60 recipes asserted without rationale; coverage categories listed but no count-to-coverage mapping, metamorphism definitions, or power justification.
findings.required_change: Provide recipe-count rationale: category allocation table, why 60 not fewer/more, metamorphic relations named only, plus frozen evaluator hash and no-leak rule.

findings.issue: Author/reviewer models, ORIGINAL volumes/profiles, separation, and schema8 slot/time/byte caps are clear, but N/S/T two-family repetitions plus ablation and clean release/publication remain external.
findings.required_change: Mark as missing prerequisites: separate prospective N/S/T multitype protocol reference and C1-C8 exact gate text; confirm this draft alone does not authorize that comparison.

findings.issue: Controls named but evaluator isolation, receipt preservation, and quota-freshness enforcement lack operational hook.
findings.required_change: Require reserved evaluator frozen before generation, invocation/streams/timeout/code retention, sentinel/missing/timeout controls separated, quota age<=600s check logged per admission.
